backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, ExpenseEntry, PermissionRequest, Message, StudyMaterial, etc.) and integrating AccessControl and Storage mixins for authorization and blob storage functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features related to reviewing ProfileSetupModal and ChatWidget for DOM nesting violations and end-to-end testing after fixes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including App.tsx, hooks, pages, and components with details on their functionality, data handling, and integration patterns.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color palette variables for light and dark modes with warm family-friendly tones and custom design tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, theme color configuration, apple mobile web app settings, and manifest/icon references for FamilyConnect application.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, display mode, theme colors, orientation, and icon configuration for FamilyConnect progressive web app.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets, network-first for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle management and offline fallback.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router, ProfileSetupModal for role selection, automatic invitation token processing using useRef to prevent loops, and navigation to dashboard after profile creation.
frontend/src/components/AIConflictAnalys: Component providing AI-powered family conflict detection and remedy suggestions with toggle control, mock conflict data, and backend logging integration.
Displays AI-generated study tips, performance insights with analysis levels, and IC technology recommendations fetched from backend queries. Shows loading states and empty states when no data is available.
frontend/src/components/ChatWidget.tsx: A draggable, collapsible chat widget for family group messaging that displays messages sorted by timestamp and allows authenticated users to send text messages. Positioned at bottom-right with drag-to-reposition functionality.
frontend/src/components/DoubtClearingInt: Provides a Q&A interface where users can submit questions, receive AI-generated answers, view conversation history with timestamps, and mark problems as resolved.
Analyzes weekly expenses across fees, groceries, and other categories, calculating percentages and generating contextual insights (tips, warnings, success messages) based on spending patterns.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseChart.tsx: Visualizes weekly expenses as horizontal bar charts for fees, groceries, and other categories with percentage indicators and a total sum display.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseInput.tsx: A form component for parents to add expenses by selecting a category (fees, groceries, other) and entering an amount in rupees. Only visible to users with parent role.
frontend/src/components/FightsCreatedWid: Displays and allows editing of the count of family conflicts/fights created, with inline edit functionality using input field and save/cancel buttons.
frontend/src/components/FightsSolvedWidg: Displays and allows editing of the count of family conflicts/fights resolved, with inline edit functionality similar to FightsCreatedWidget but styled with green/success theme.
frontend/src/components/HappinessMeter.t: Displays a family happiness score (0-100%) with color-coded progress bar and emoji icons that change based on score thresholds (70+, 40-70, <40).
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component providing header with authentication, navigation sidebar with icons for different sections, and onboarding guidance for share button highlighting.
frontend/src/components/PermissionApprov: Parent-facing component that displays pending permission requests from children with approve/deny buttons for each request.
frontend/src/components/PermissionReques: Child-facing form component for submitting permission requests to parents, including activity type selection, reason textarea, and parent principal ID input.
frontend/src/components/ProblemsSolvedWi: Displays the total count of educational problems/doubts that have been resolved, shown with a trophy icon and badge.
frontend/src/components/ShareApp.tsx: A dialog component that allows users to share the FamilyConnect app URL with family members via a copy-to-clipboard button. Includes an optional highlighted/animated state to draw attention to the share button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Automatically invalidates and refetches dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatWidget.ts: Custom hook for managing chat widget state (open/closed and horizontal position) with localStorage persistence. Provides toggle, open, and close functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle. Exports InternetIdentityProvider component and useInternetIdentity hook for accessing auth state and methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboarding.ts: Custom hook for managing multi-step onboarding flow state with localStorage persistence. Tracks completion of steps like role selection, family connection, and dashboard visits.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for all backend API calls including user profiles, expenses, messages, permissions, locations, educational data, and family invitations. Exports type definitions and mutation/query hooks with error handling and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, family-friendly color palette for both light and dark modes. Includes base styles and color tokens for consistent theming.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Chat page component supporting group and private messaging with multiple message types (text, grocery lists, social media links). Includes AI conflict analysis and family member selection for private chats.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying family metrics (happiness, problems solved, fights, expenses) with role-based widgets and onboarding guidance for parents and children to connect family members.
frontend/src/pages/EducationalHub.tsx: Educational hub page with tabs for uploading question papers and answer scripts, viewing materials, AI analysis results, and a doubt-clearing interface with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/LocationSharing.tsx: Location sharing page that allows users to share their current GPS coordinates with family members and view family locations using browser geolocation API.
frontend/src/pages/MediaGallery.tsx: Media gallery page for uploading and displaying family photos and videos with descriptions, upload progress tracking, and profile-based attribution.
frontend/src/pages/Reminders.tsx: Family reminders page for creating and viewing time-based reminders with status indicators (overdue, due soon, upcoming) sorted by due date.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page component that allows authenticated users to update their profile, generate family invitation links (for parents), view active invitations, and delete their account with role-based UI differences.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (including warm palette), typography, container settings, border radius variables, and animation keyframes for the application's design system.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking architectural decisions, known issues (including React errors and missing UI elements), existing features (dashboard, messaging, happiness meter, AI analysis), and the current project state version (45).
